quest.124FCA0AAA1732D4.quest_desc: &eInputs&r are &dessential&r, because they move &eitems&r, &bfluids&r, &5gases&r and &aenergy&r, only those
They can move a lot of &6items&r in &done&r go, how many? Well, more than an &5max upgraded&r drawer can support....
Where <filter> can be empty for all &eitems&r, you can also say &dhere&r that you want to move &bfluids&r or &5gases&r or &aenergy&r by using &bfluid::&r or &5gas::&r or &afe::&r
You can also do &bmultiple&r &dfilters&r at the same &6time&r using a comma or if you want to filter an specific &eitem&r, you can also do that by using their &did&r (minecraft:dirt for example).
<label> can be &aanything&r as long as is not "label" or label or has special characters. For those, you need to &5put&r them in between "<label>"
You can also put &cmultiple&r &dlabels&r using commas
quest.12794490993D0EA2.quest_desc: &cRedstone&r is very limited with S&6FM&r but you can do some &acool&r things with it.
- You can &davoid&r the use of "eve&bry&r 20 ticks do" and go &afaster&r, up to 2 ticks intervals -> every &credstone&r pulse do
- Checks with &aIF&r statments -> if &credstone&r eq 15 then ....
You can only do this on a &6Manager&r block, not &ecables&r!
quest.16DAFFBAAAA8E43C.quest_desc: &dCurrently&r, there are only 5 &aresources&r type that &6SFM&r can &aunderstand&r or move

- &eitem&r:<modid>:<item> (used by &ddefault&r) -> Represents &eitems&r, like a stone or coal block. This is the &5default&r filter, so you &edon't&r need to specify item::, but optionally you can &dspecify&r the <modid> and <item>. If you mix &bfluids&r and &eitems&r, you need to &6specify&r it

- &bfluid&r:<modid>:<liquid> -> Represents &bfluids&r or &9liquids,&r like water or lava. You need to specify at &eleast&r &bfluid::&r to use it. Normally, you would do fluid::<liquid> because most &amods&r doesn't add the same fluid

- &5gas&r:<modid>:<gas> -> Represents a &5gas&r from &aMekanism&r mod. You need to specify at &eleast&r &5gas::&r to use it. Normally, &amods&r doesn't add new &echemicals&r, so you can use gas::<gas>

- &cRedstone&r -> Yes, &6SFM&r can read &credstone&r, but it's very limited, only on the &amanager&r block, not on the &einventory&r cables. It can &bread&r from 0 (no redstone) to 15 (max redstone). It can't send &credstone&r &asignals&r, but you can &dsolve&r this by using some &6chests&r and &acomparators&r
- &aEnergy&r (&afe::&r) -> Well, not GT one, but for &dalmost&r all &6machines&r
quest.1A40816813B61A7D.quest_desc: &dOnly&r can be used on &ainput&r and &coutput&r, and has different effects:
- &aInput&r -> Tells SFM to &6leave&r the inventory with at least X &anumber&r of items or fluid or gas
&eFor example&r, you want to have at least 64 or more &7stone&r on a drawer but not less than that.
Syntax: input <filters> retain X <other filters> from <label>
- &cOutput&r -> Tells SFM that the &dlabel&r can have a &cmax&r amount &ainside&r
For example, you want a &6crusher&r to have 9 &amelon&r slices but not more than that
Syntax: output <filters> retain X <other filters> to <label>
Where X is the &6number&r of items or millibuckets and <other filters> are the &dfilters&r that SFM will use on the &6retain&r
quest.1DFD9386E6755838.quest_desc: This is similar to &5retain&r, but instead it works with &etags&r!
You can &acombine&r both and they go on the &6same&r place, here are the details:
- &5With&r -> Tells SFM to input/output items, fluids or gas with a &aspecific&r tag
- &dWithout&r -> Tells SFM to input/output items, fluids or gas without a &especific&r tag
Where <tag> is the &atag&r you want to &cfilter&r

quest.29DF1D629BE2DEBD.quest_desc: Since this is a 3D &dgame&r about cubes, there are 7 &bsides&r <sides> :)
- &5TOP&r
- &dBOTTOM&r
- &eEAST&r
- &aWEST&r
- &6SOUTH&r
- &bNORTH&r
- &cnull&r aka &cno side&r (left blank to specify this one)
Most &amachines&r accepts the &cnull&r side too, but some others, it can only &ause&r them with a specify side, like &aMekanism&r's machines.
If you are not sure which side is, just use "&5each&r side".
Syntax: &ainput&r from <label> (optionally, &5each&r, but you need to avoid <sides>) <sides> side
{@pagebreak}
&6Slots&r works a bit &edifferent&r than what you see.
Some of them are &dvisible&r to SFM, for example, the &coutput&r side of a machine, but others &4&laren't&r, like the &6upgrade&r slots.
Some &emods&r allows you &6see&r them, but they are limited, like &aProductive&r&6Bees&r.
You can &bcheck&r the slots with the &dkeycombo&r of CTRL+I, but this is not 100% true
You can &bspecify&r a list of &6slots&r or &done&r slots or a &arange&r
Syntax: output to <label> slots <list, number of slot or range>
&dExamples&r of each type:
output to <label> slots 1,3,5,7 &7--only slots 1, 3, 5 and 7 are affected&r
output to <label> slots 1 &7--only slot 1 is affected&r
output to <label> slots 1-7 &7--slots from 1 to 7 are affected&r

quest.62412CB349BDB687.quest_desc: Pick &call&r the &dblocks&r you would need for your &asetup&r.
For example, lets say a &6mob farm&r, well, you place the item &bcollectors&r, the &btrashcans&r, and &emachines&r to recycle and to storage.

quest.685C72855D1C39E5.quest_desc: IF &dstatments&r allows you to &acheck&r if certain &econditions&r has being met, like if some &dmachine&r has X amount of &6items&r or if the &6manager&r block has received a &credstone&r signal
If that &econdition&r hasn't been met, you can use the &celse&r &dstatment&r to do &esomething&r or if you want to check another &5condition&r if the first one has met.
The following &dstatments&r can be used for checking &bquantities&r or <checker>:
The following &dstatments&r can be &aused&r for combining &bmultiples&r conditions or <linkers>:
- &3AND&r -> Checks if 2 or more conditions are met
- &2OR&r -> Checks if at least 1 condition is met

Where <modifier> can be &5each&r, &dsome&r or &bone&r or &enot&r (you can combine not with some or each or one), <condition> would be <modifier> <label> has <checker> X <filter>, and X is the &6number&r to check the &econdition&r
quest.6AA8B7AE8A952909.quest_desc: &dEvery&r keyword determines how &6often&r the program will run.
Where X is the &enumber&r of ticks or seconds. You can only &6choose&r ticks or seconds, but &cnot&r both.
By default, only &aenergy&r can be done in a "&devery&r 1 ticks do" and the &brest&r can be &6done&r in "every 20 ticks do" or &ehigher&r
There is a trick to &6avoid&r the 20 ticks delay by using a "every &credstone&r pulse do", but you need a 2 &bticks&r redstone clock, like with 2 &eobservers&r, on the &6manager&r block
quest.6AA8B7AE8A952909.title: Every Keyword
quest.6DB4CDB6DF44FFFF.quest_desc: &eRound robin&r allows you to send &eitems&r to one &alabel&r or &6block&r at the time.
For most setups, this is &duseless&r because &5retain&r do a much &6better&r work to distribute &eitems&r or &bfluids&r or &5gases&r across &6multiple&r inventory.
&dFor example&r, lets say that you have an "every 1 ticks do", then, in one &6second&r, you can do 20 &dmachines&r, while with &5retain&r you can more more than that (100+) every single tick.
You can also use "&cby label&r" instead, but you would &aneed&r 2 labels on the &bstatments&r
You can use &eround robin&r in 2 ways, &aby block&r and &cby label&r
- &aBy block&r -> Goes one block at the time
- &cBy label&r -> If you have an input / output statment with 2 &blabels&r, it will go to to label A and then go to label B
Syntax: input from <label> round robin by <block or label, just those options>
quest.7B5EF3CA06074AF9.quest_desc: This is all the &eitems&r needed to start with this &amod&r.

- &aView logs&r -> This has a lot of &dinformation&r, useful when you have to &3guess&r what happened
- &9Discord&r -> To &eask&r for help, don't be afraid, everyone &cfails&r at the beginning. Also, they have &aexamples&r already and how to &bsetup&r them!
After you have the &dsetup&r and &acode&r ready, you need to get the &blabels&r (a.k.a the machines).
